title: Clo Vendor Leaderboard Highlights
description:
In a rapidly evolving global apparel landscape, a new benchmark for digital excellence has arrived. Hear from this year's CLO Vendor Leaderboard partners, Busana Apparel Group, Cobalt Fashion, Daehan Global, GMS+, Hop Lun, Newtimes Group of Companies and PT. Kahatex on their digital journey and the impact of this initiative, making it easier than ever for brands to connect with 3D ready partners.

Moving beyond individual success stories, we’ve identified a consistent blueprint for digital leadership. A clear pattern emerged: success is less about the tools themselves and more about how these vendors transform the brand-partner dynamic and evolve their workflows based on the critical factors that drive real business impact.

markdown_content: ## CLO Leaderboard Program: Purpose and Value This section describes what the CLO Leaderboard program is meant to do—serve as a natural progression of CLO relationships and a platform for brands and vendors to align. It highlights how participation supports visibility, partnership readiness, and connection across the “3D and digital journey.” The speaker frames the CLO Leaderboard as a natural progression of a long relationship with CLO. Participating in the CLO Leaderboard program is presented as a major opportunity for NewTimes to showcase capabilities and present them to a broader audience through the initiative. The platform is described as a way to show more of the work and connect with clients, while signaling to brands that the vendor is ready to partner and provide support regardless of where the brands are in their 3D and digital journey. The speaker emphasizes that the CLO Leaderboard is “where the brand and vendor align and connect,” positioning it as a mechanism for collaboration rather than just participation. The program is also associated with global expansion—specifically expanding the business of hardware and textiles—indicating that the initiative spans multiple product categories and supports broader business development goals. ## NewTimes’ Objectives: Exposure, Expertise, and Client Connections This section focuses on NewTimes’ motivations for joining the program, including gaining exposure, showcasing 3D expertise, and strengthening client relationships across different stages of digital adoption. NewTimes joins the initiative to create a new platform for visibility and engagement. The speaker hopes to use the platform to gain more exposure and showcase expertise in 3D, while connecting with clients and supporting them regardless of where they are on their 3D and digital journey. The intent is to demonstrate work, communicate capabilities, and maintain relevance to client needs as they progress through digital transformation. The speaker reiterates that the program offers an opportunity to work closely with partners, share ideas, and co-create value. This is presented as a collaborative approach—using the platform to foster deeper cooperation with customers and strengthen relationships through shared innovation and design efforts. ## Innovation, Sustainability, and Customer Cooperation This section outlines the innovation and sustainability drivers behind participation, describing how the program supports design innovation, sustainability practices, and deeper customer collaboration. The speaker highlights the opportunity to explore innovation in design, enhance sustainability practice, and foster deeper cooperation with customers. These are identified as important drivers of success. The CLO Leaderboard initiative is therefore positioned not only as a marketing or exposure channel, but also as a vehicle for meaningful progress in design innovation and sustainability-oriented practices. By aligning with CLO’s digital ecosystem, NewTimes aims to strengthen cooperation with customers through shared ideas and co-creation, using 3D as a core focus for future-facing development. ## Leadership and “Digital-First” Working Across Product Categories This section explains how participation is intended to establish leadership and increase visibility for digital-first workflows across multiple categories, reinforcing the idea that the vendor should lead rather than follow. The speaker states that joining is about leadership: “So we are not here just to participate we are here to lead.” The rationale includes the belief that 3D is the future—an enabling technology that allows the company to shape the future rather than merely follow it. Participation is also described as endorsing leadership and increasing visibility as a “propagator of digital first way of working across multiple product categories.” This positions NewTimes as an active driver of digital-first adoption across different segments, rather than a passive participant in an initiative.
